facts: As of November 14, 2026, Wodify's authentication guide says to go to Automations → Integrations in Wodify Core, open the API & MCP section, and click Add API Key.
Send the key in an x-api-key header on every request.
Quota: 500,000 requests per month.
The Partner API Access article was last updated November 13, 2026, and the Submit an API Application article November 10, 2026.
The Partner API is for established platforms with multi-user credentials, webhooks, two-way sync and GPX routes.
Partner API rate limit is 1,000 calls per minute.
Terra's webhook docs now name the signature header X-Terra-Signature.
When the retries run out, Terra marks the delivery failed; Terra says to "Resend failed events from the Events page of the dashboard".
No single request may span more than 1,825 days.
The data-sources table lists "Fitbit (Removed Support)" as of November 14, 2026 ("Fitbit (Deprecated)" on November 2).
Start Up: starts at 499 euros a month; additional users 0.50 euros each.
Scale Up: starts at 1,000 euros a month.
Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial.
Pro: $1,499 a month, billed annually.
As of November 18, 2026, its docs list Garmin, Oura and WHOOP, each marked "GA".
Garmin's FAQ describes Starter Access as immediate access to core data and tools.
Starter is push-only, has no historical data and has limited user capacity.
A typical integration takes one to four weeks.
New WHOOP apps start on a Sandbox tier of 10 members.
Each request is reviewed by hand.
WHOOP's developer overview requires a WHOOP membership to develop an app.
Oura limits an application to 10 users before approval.
There is no limit once approved.
Personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available.
